pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with high edge angularity and sharp vertices. Spatial area varies significantly, with smaller, more fragmented patches appearing toward the ventral-posterior regions, and larger, more cohesive blocks on the mid-flank and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected web of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes exhibit high connectivity with mostly 3-way convergent paths. Pathway thickness is relatively thin and consistent across the mid-flank, with slight widening at the intersection nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dense, brush-like silhouette is visible along the dorsal neck line, presenting a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile against the background.
